newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-TELE-COMMUNICATIONS Q2 NET LOSS DOWN.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-TELE-COMMUNICATIONS Q2 NET LOSS DOWN.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE - Q2 per share for TCI Group Series A and B common stock was loss $0.25 vs loss $0.30; Q2 per share figures for Liberty Media Group Series A and B common stock was a profit of $0.03 vs profit $0.02.

For the six month period, per share for TCI Group Series A and B common stock was loss $0.37 vs loss $0.52; The six month results for Liberty Media Group Series A and B common stock was a profit of $0.09 vs profit $0.08.

TCI's year-over-year revenue decrease was attributed primarily to electronic retailing services no longer being consolidated with the financial results of Liberty Media Group, and to its spin-off of its satellite business, both of which occurred in December 1996.
Full company name is Tele-Communications Inc
The company was not immediately available to provide further details.
